parts.text:
An anniversary ring is such a meaningful choice, and yellow gold gives this search a warm, timeless feel. I found two genuine directions, both in-stock and first-quality:

- **Halo:** Traditional and polished, with emerald-cut lab-grown diamond centers in 14K yellow gold. The options range from a more moderate scale to a larger statement look.
- **Three-stone:** [Champagne and White Diamond 14K Yellow Gold Ring](/product/PAC095), a particularly fitting anniversary direction with three round mined diamonds and a champagne center.

I wasn’t able to stage the product cards successfully this time, so they aren’t displayed yet. The search did not return enough eligible solitaire choices to show that as a complete direction, and several alternatives were unavailable or conflicted with the yellow-gold requirement.
